Kuber · Web v1 · Inner pages

Web v1 · Screenshots

Every app screenshot on the site, redrawn as the same screen in the M3 app UI from this project. Plain screens, Kuber Signature light and dark, same pixel size as the original (1080 wide; drawn at 360 dp and exported at 3x). Exported to web-v1/screenshots/<folder>/<name>-light.png and -dark.png. Map: screenshot-map.md.
